summary: With Simple Content Access (the default), attaching an AAP subscription only needs `subscription-manager register`; verify with `subscription-manager refresh` and `subscription-manager identity`, no pool attach required.
questions: How do I attach my AAP subscription on RHEL?
Do I still need subscription-manager attach --pool with SCA?
How do I verify my system registration for AAP?

answer_card.title: Attach the AAP subscription (SCA)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
sudo subscription-manager register --username <user> --password <pass>
sudo subscription-manager refresh
sudo subscription-manager identity   # verify
```
With Simple Content Access, registering is the only step; `attach --pool` is not needed.
